description: Mixture-of-tables BitReadout = Mixture-of-Softmaxes with popcount experts. exp513 backbone; head = T=8 NAP=15 tables, each a Hamming-normal softmax over V (logit=popcount of x's 15-bit anchor code vs token's 15-bit code), MIXED by a context gate: P(v)=Σ_t π_t(x)·softmax_t(v). Unlike summing/product (which collapse to one flat Hamming-normal = exp546), the MIXTURE is multimodal and breaks the softmax rank bottleneck (the real exploit of 'many NAP=15 tables'). Per-table gradient checkpointing (~36GB). matmul-free experts + tiny gate. Returns normalized log-probs. vs exp513 Linear 1.4825/1.4656; exp546 flat BitReadout plateaued ~+0.28.
